simple.summary: שׁוּעַ (Shûwaʻ) means Shua , a Canaanite First listed occurrence: Gen 38 2.

definitions.full: H7770. Shuwa ' I. שׁוּעַ proper name, masculine father of Judah's wife , ᵐ5 Σαυα , Gen 38:2 and (after construct בַּת ) 38:12 ; 1Chr 2:3 ; see בַּתשֿׁוּע above, and compare on meaning (אֲבִי)שׁוּעַ p. 4, (אֱלִי)שׁוּעַ p. 4:6 .
